Marta (People Ops): hey folks, dropping the compact manager + HR checklist i put together for first-week onboarding. want quick eyes so i can lock it before monday.

Marta (People Ops): includes day-by-day schedule, manager prompts for 30/60/90, hr paperwork timeline, and a short "what to tell the new hire 48hr before" blurb.

Marta (People Ops): ```
Manager/HR compact checklist (single-page):
- Pre-day (-2 to -1): send day-1 prep email, confirm shipping, invite to calendar, assign buddy.
- Day 0 (equipment): asset shipped + tracking, slack invite, welcome doc link.
- Day 1 (welcome): 9:00 people-ops intro, 10:00 hr forms & benefits, 1:30 team kick + manager 1:1 (45m), 3:30 access review + dev env setup.
- Day 2: security & SSO onboarding, enroll MDM, grant repo & cloud access.
- Day 3: product walkthrough, codebase tour, first small task assigned.
- Day 4: paired work with buddy, feedback sync.
- Day 5: manager check-in, finalize 30/60/90 draft, schedule recurring 1:1s.

Manager 30/60/90 prompts (send to hire by day 7):
- 30d: what will you learn? who to meet? env & tooling complete?
- 60d: what will you contribute? list one deliverable and expected timeline.
- 90d: ownership area + metric of success.

HR timeline: I-9 & payroll day 1, benefits enrollment window within 30 days, probation review at 60 days.

Pre-day-1 email (48h): link to org chart, doc with timezone-aware meeting times, parking/logistics, short product primer (5 min).
```

Raj (Eng Manager): love the compact version. can we add a standard team kickoff agenda: intros (10m), live demo (15m), codebase pointers (15m), expectations & weekly cadence (20m)?

Marta (People Ops): yep adding team kickoff template.

Ivy (HR): couple of notes: 1) remote hires: add explicit timezone availability for onboarding week; 2) accessibility: ask for any accommodations ahead of time; 3) remind managers to cover parental leave policy in benefits intro if relevant.

Sam (IT): small ask: please confirm whether the new hire needs admin unix account on day 1 or after access training. security usually asks day 2. also include a field for monitor adapters (USB-C vs DisplayPort).

Marta (People Ops): default to admin day 2 post-MDM. adding monitor adapter field and a checkbox for VPN + GH access request.

Raj (Eng Manager): manager note: i set expectation for new engineers to draft a personal 30/60/90 by the end of week 2. i'll review in week 3 cadence. adding that to the template.

Eli (New Hire): quick q 3 what should i skim before day 1?

Tara (Recruiter): @Eli we'll send a "how to prep" email 48hrs prior with two short reads: product one-pager (5 min) and repo README (10 min). also your buddy intro in Slack.

DevOps-Bot: Reminder scheduled: create onboarding ticket for Eli #ONB-5234, due date: day 0.

Ivy (HR): Marta -- please add a line for "probation outcome options" so managers know the formal steps for 60-day check.

Marta (People Ops): done. also adding a tiny checklist table to the doc for people ops/it/hr/manager signoffs.

Raj (Eng Manager): one more practical: include a short list of "who to ask" items for day 1 (eg: who to talk to for infra creds, who owns on-call, who handles expenses).

Marta (People Ops): added a "who to ask" quick list and a one-liner about inclusive onboarding (pronouns, captions, dietary needs for in-person).

Sam (IT): I'll ensure device tracking tags are in the doc and link the asset request form.

Eli (New Hire): thanks all! excited. maybe add recommended slack channels to join? (#eng, #dev-help, #random)

Marta (People Ops): good idea adding recommended channels in the pre-day email. final ask: any big objections to publishing this as the default manager onboarding checklist?

Raj (Eng Manager): none from me. looks ready.

Ivy (HR): good to publish.

Tara (Recruiter): all good. i'll fold into the offer pack emails moving forward.

Marta (People Ops): thanks team 73; will publish and share link. closing thread in a few.
